newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen up on U.S. producer prices.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen up on U.S. producer prices.

text.p: Argentine stocks were seen supported at the opening Friday on the back of moderate U.S. producer prices which boosted U.S. markets.
"Stocks will be supported by the U.S. figures," said a trader at an Argentine bank. The U.S. Labor Department announced Friday a rise of 0.2 percent in producer prices in September.
Market players said stocks would also benefit from the growing feeling that Argentine fundamentals, mainly rising growth, will fuel improved earnings for companies.
That sentiment pushed the Merval leading blue-chip stock index .MERV 0.25 percent higher to 584.61 Thursday.
"The market is set to rise today but it could be kept back by low liquidity," said Dario Lizzano, a trader at Rio Valores, who predicted selective interest this session.
